why: Chris, 8 October 2026: "what has happened to proper bronze, silver and gold badges per lesson?" - his choice: real medal art, and each lesson showing its medal. A lesson badge is bronze (finished), silver (70%) or gold (90%, most right first time). LessonMedalHtml() (AIPascalCourse lib/collectables.php) uses public/assets/lesson-medals/<tier>.png once it exists and draws a medal until then; it shows on Achievements (Lesson badges, Overview, Nearly there, Lately), the badge pop-up and each lesson on the course page, from 26 to 72 pixels - so a bold, simple silhouette that reads small.
style: A glossy 3D game reward medal, smooth shiny polished metal with a soft studio light, like a reward in a mobile game, matching the site's glossy badge look. A round medal hanging from a short folded deep-blue ribbon, the medal face with a simple raised five-pointed star in the middle and a raised rim. The whole medal and ribbon centred on a plain pure white background with space all around it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
